channel.title: Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty (rferl.org)

item.title: Middle Eastern Countries Report Apparent Iranian Counterstrikes
item.description: Damage from Iranian counterstrikes that followed a joint US-Israeli air attack on February 28 has been reported in Israel, Bahrain, and Qatar. Blasts were heard in the Qatari capital, Doha, and smoke billowed over Bahrain hours after the air strikes on Iran.

item.title: Dubai's Landmark Island In Smoke Amid Iranian Strikes
item.description: Huge pillar of smoke rose from Dubai's famous landmark -- the man-made island, Palm Jumeirah. As Iran carries out retaliatory strikes in the region following US and Israeli attacks, at least four people were injured in the incident, the Dubai government press service reported.

item.title: Marc Thiessen: 'The Ground Forces Are The Iranian People'
item.description: A prominent US political commentator and RFE/RL board member says the latest American strikes on Iran mark the beginning of a sustained campaign aimed not just at military deterrence but at ending the rule of the Islamic republic as it currently exists.

item.title: Iranian State Media Confirm Khamenei's Death After US, Israeli Air Strikes
item.description: Iranian state media confirmed early on March 1 that Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed amid US and Israeli air strikes, hours after US President Donald Trump announced the death on his social media platform.

item.title: US Says Iran Rejected Nuclear Offer Before Preemptive Strikes
item.description: The United States said on February 28 that it launched preemptive military strikes against Iran after concluding that Tehran was preparing to use its missile arsenal against US forces and allies and had no intention of agreeing to meaningful limits on its nuclear program.

item.title: Celebrations In Iran After Trump Says Ayatollah Killed In Strikes
item.description: Videos shared on social media show people celebrating in Iran after US President Donald Trump wrote that Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei had been killed in US and Israeli air strikes. An Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman denied the reports, saying Khamenei was safe.

item.title: General Jack Keane Says US-Israeli Operation Aims to Dismantle Iranian Leadership
item.description: General Jack Keane, a retired four-star general and former Vice Chief of Staff of the U.S. Army, says the US-Israeli military campaign launched against Iran on February 28 is a calculated effort to dismantle the Islamic Republic’s political and military architecture.

item.title: Israel, Iran Launch New Strikes After Death Of Khamenei
item.description: Following reports of the death of Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Israel continued to pound sites in Iran on the second day of a massive joint attack by Tel Aviv and Washington on the Islamic republic.

item.title: Ali Khamenei, Iran’s Highest Authority, Dead At 86
item.description: Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Iran’s spiritual leader and highest authority who led the country for almost four decades, was killed during US and Israeli air strikes on February at the age of 86.

item.title: Ali Khamenei, Iran's Hard-Line Authoritarian Supreme Leader, Dead At 86
item.description: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei ruled Iran for decades. His supporters saw him as a wise leader, his critics as an authoritarian who led the Islamic republic into further international isolation. His latter years as supreme leader were marred by mass protests and a brutal crackdown that killed thousands.
